senses.definition: physical harm to a part of the body, for example in an accident or while doing sport

examples.text: He missed the match because of a knee injury.
examples.translation: O, diz zədəsinə görə matçda iştirak edə bilmədi.

examples.text: Luckily, nobody suffered serious injuries in the accident.
examples.translation: Xoşbəxtlikdən, qəzada heç kim ciddi xəsarət almadı.

senses.definition: to become healthy or strong again after an illness, an injury or a difficult time

examples.text: It took her two weeks to recover from the flu.
examples.translation: Qripdən sağalmaq ona iki həftə çəkdi.

examples.text: He is recovering well after the operation.

senses.definition: a sign that you have an illness, such as a high temperature or a cough

examples.text: A sore throat is a common symptom of a cold.
examples.translation: Boğaz ağrısı soyuqdəymənin geniş yayılmış əlamətidir.

examples.text: Tell the doctor about all your symptoms.

senses.definition: a paper from a doctor that says which medicine you need, so you can get it from a pharmacy

examples.text: The doctor gave me a prescription for some cough syrup.
examples.translation: Həkim mənə öskürək şərbəti üçün resept yazdı.

examples.text: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription.

senses.definition: a pain that continues for a long time but is not very strong

examples.text: I have a dull ache in my back.
After the long walk, she felt an ache in her legs.
examples.translation: Uzun gəzintidən sonra ayaqlarında ağrı hiss etdi.

senses.definition: to feel a pain that continues for some time

examples.text: My feet ache after a long day at work.
examples.translation: İşdə uzun bir gündən sonra ayaqlarım ağrıyır.

examples.text: His whole body ached after the football match.
examples.translation: Futbol oyunundan sonra bütün bədəni ağrıyırdı.

senses.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are ill

examples.text: The child has had a fever since yesterday.
Drink a lot of water when you have a fever.

senses.definition: the action or sound of pushing air out of your throat suddenly, often when you are ill

examples.text: I have a bad cough and a sore throat.
examples.translation: Pis öskürəyim və boğaz ağrım var.

examples.text: This syrup will help your cough.

senses.definition: to push air out of your throat suddenly with a loud sound

examples.text: He coughed all night.
Cover your mouth when you cough.

senses.definition: to suddenly blow air out of your nose and mouth, for example when you have a cold

examples.text: Dust always makes me sneeze.
She sneezed three times in a row.

senses.definition: a long piece of cloth that you put around an injured part of the body

examples.text: The nurse put a bandage on my arm.
You should change the bandage every day.

senses.definition: to become healthy again, or to make a wound or an injury healthy again

homonyms.meaning: the back part of your foot (sounds the same as "heal")

examples.text: The cut on my finger healed in a week.
This cream helps the skin heal faster.
examples.translation: Bu krem dərinin daha tez sağalmasına kömək edir.

senses.definition: a store where you can buy medicine

examples.text: Is there a pharmacy near here?
I picked up my medicine at the pharmacy.

senses.definition: bigger than usual because of an injury or an illness

examples.text: My ankle is still swollen.
Her eyes were red and swollen.

senses.definition: feeling that everything is turning around you and that you may fall

examples.text: I felt dizzy when I stood up too quickly.
examples.translation: Çox tez ayağa qalxanda başım gicəlləndi.

examples.text: The heat made him dizzy.

senses.definition: the care or medicine that a doctor gives to a sick or injured person

examples.text: The treatment for a sprained ankle is rest and ice.
examples.translation: Burxulmuş topuğun müalicəsi istirahət və buzdur.

examples.text: She is getting treatment for her back.

senses.definition: having a bad reaction in your body to something, such as food, dust or animals

examples.text: I'm allergic to cats.
Are you allergic to any medicine?

sentences.text: Kamran has run in many races, but he has never had a serious injury.
sentences.translation: Kamran çoxlu yarışda qaçıb, amma heç vaxt ciddi zədə almayıb.

sentences.text: He has never even had a fever or a bad cough in the last five years.
sentences.translation: Son beş ildə onun heç qızdırması, ya da pis öskürəyi də olmayıb.

sentences.text: Last Sunday, while he was running in the park, he stepped on a stone and twisted his ankle.
sentences.translation: Keçən bazar günü parkda qaçarkən bir daşın üstünə basdı və topuğunu burxdu.

sentences.text: At first he felt only a small ache, so he kept going.
sentences.translation: Əvvəlcə yalnız yüngül ağrı hiss etdi, ona görə də qaçmağa davam etdi.

sentences.text: By evening, his foot was swollen, and it hurt to walk.
sentences.translation: Axşama yaxın ayağı şişmişdi və yerimək ağrılı idi.

sentences.text: The next morning he went to the clinic.
sentences.translation: Səhəri gün klinikaya getdi.

sentences.text: In the waiting room, a little boy was coughing, and an old man was sneezing into his handkerchief.
sentences.translation: Gözləmə otağında balaca bir oğlan öskürürdü, yaşlı bir kişi isə dəsmalına asqırırdı.

sentences.text: “Have you ever hurt this ankle before?” the doctor asked.
sentences.translation: «Bu topuğunuzu əvvəllər heç zədələmisiniz?» – deyə həkim soruşdu.

sentences.text: “No, never,” Kamran answered, and he described his symptoms: pain, swelling and a feeling of heat.
sentences.translation: «Xeyr, heç vaxt», – deyə Kamran cavab verdi və simptomlarını təsvir etdi: ağrı, şişkinlik və istilik hissi.

sentences.text: “Do you ever feel dizzy when you stand on it?” she asked.
sentences.translation: «Ayağınızın üstündə duranda heç başınız gicəllənir?» – deyə həkim soruşdu.

sentences.text: “No, I've never felt dizzy,” he said.
sentences.translation: «Xeyr, heç vaxt başım gicəllənməyib», – dedi.

sentences.text: The doctor said it was a sprain, not a break.
sentences.translation: Həkim bunun sınıq yox, burxulma olduğunu dedi.

sentences.text: She put a tight bandage around his ankle and wrote him a prescription for a cream.
sentences.translation: Topuğuna möhkəm sarğı qoydu və ona krem üçün resept yazdı.

sentences.text: “Are you allergic to any medicine?” she asked, and Kamran shook his head.
sentences.translation: «Hansısa dərmana allergiyanız var?» – deyə soruşdu, Kamran isə başını buladı.

sentences.text: “The treatment is simple: rest, ice and this cream,” she explained.
sentences.translation: «Müalicə sadədir: istirahət, buz və bu krem», – deyə həkim izah etdi.

sentences.text: “You will recover in about three weeks, but your ankle needs time to heal, so please don't run.”
sentences.translation: «Təxminən üç həftəyə sağalacaqsınız, amma topuğunuzun tam sağalması üçün vaxt lazımdır, ona görə də, xahiş edirəm, qaçmayın».

sentences.text: On the way home, Kamran stopped at the pharmacy and bought the cream.
sentences.translation: Evə qayıdarkən Kamran aptekə dəydi və kremi aldı.

sentences.text: The pharmacist, a kind young woman, has helped many runners, and she gave him some useful advice.
sentences.translation: Əczaçı – mehriban bir gənc qadın – çoxlu qaçışçıya kömək edib və ona bir neçə faydalı məsləhət verdi.

sentences.text: Now Kamran is resting at home with his foot on a pillow.
sentences.translation: İndi Kamran ayağını yastığın üstünə qoyub evdə dincəlir.

sentences.text: It isn't easy, because he has never stayed still for so long.
sentences.translation: Bu, asan deyil, çünki o, heç vaxt bu qədər uzun müddət tərpənmədən qalmayıb.

sentences.text: His back aches a little from lying in bed all day, but his ankle feels better every morning.
sentences.translation: Bütün günü yataqda uzanmaqdan beli bir az ağrıyır, amma topuğu hər səhər daha yaxşı olur.

sentences.text: His friends from the running club have visited him twice and brought fruit and funny movies.
sentences.translation: Qaçış klubundan olan dostları ona iki dəfə baş çəkib, meyvə və gülməli filmlər gətiriblər.

sentences.text: He has also discovered something new: he has never read so many books in his life!
sentences.translation: O, həm də yeni bir şey kəşf edib: həyatında heç vaxt bu qədər çox kitab oxumayıb!

sentences.text: “Have you ever thought about writing about running?” his sister asked him yesterday.
sentences.translation: «Heç qaçış haqqında yazmağı düşünmüsən?» – deyə bacısı dünən ondan soruşdu.

sentences.text: Kamran smiled, opened his laptop and started his first blog post: “What I Have Learned from My Injury.”
sentences.translation: Kamran gülümsədi, noutbukunu açdı və ilk bloq yazısına başladı: «Zədəmdən nə öyrəndim».

sentences.text: The first lesson, he wrote, is simple: listen to your body before it starts to shout.
sentences.translation: O yazdı ki, birinci dərs sadədir: bədənin qışqırmağa başlamazdan əvvəl ona qulaq as.

grammar.explanation: We use the present perfect (have/has + past participle) to talk about experiences in our life up to now. We don't say when it happened, because the time is not important. We use ever in questions to mean “at any time in your life”, and never to mean “not at any time”. If we add a specific past time, we change to the past simple.
grammar.explanationTranslation: Present perfect (have/has + feilin üçüncü forması) indiyə qədər həyatımızda olan təcrübələr haqqında danışmaq üçün işlədilir. Bunun nə vaxt baş verdiyini demirik, çünki vaxt vacib deyil. Ever sual cümlələrində “həyatında nə vaxtsa”, never isə “heç vaxt” mənasında işlədilir. Konkret keçmiş vaxtı əlavə etsək, past simple işlədirik.

rules.text: Form: have/has + past participle (I have seen, she has visited).
rules.translation: Quruluş: have/has + feilin üçüncü forması (I have seen, she has visited).

rules.text: Questions: Have/Has + subject + ever + past participle? (Have you ever broken a bone?)
rules.translation: Sual: Have/Has + mübtəda + ever + feilin üçüncü forması? (Have you ever broken a bone?)

rules.text: Never already has a negative meaning, so don't use not with it: say “I have never been there”, not “I haven't never been there”.
rules.translation: Never özü inkar mənası daşıyır, ona görə onunla not işlədilmir: “I haven't never been there” yox, “I have never been there” deyilir.

rules.text: Ever and never go between have/has and the past participle.
rules.translation: Ever və never have/has ilə feilin üçüncü forması arasında gəlir.

examples.text: Have you ever had a serious injury?
I have never broken a bone.
She has been in the hospital only once in her life.
examples.translation: O, həyatında yalnız bir dəfə xəstəxanada yatıb.

examples.text: My grandfather has never needed a prescription for anything.
examples.translation: Babamın heç vaxt heç nə üçün reseptə ehtiyacı olmayıb.

examples.text: Have you ever eaten Azerbaijani plov?

exercise.instructions: Choose or write the correct form of the verb.
exercise.instructionsTranslation: Feilin düzgün formasını seçin və ya yazın.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ___ in a hospital?
questions.explanation: After have + ever we use the past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: Have + ever-dən sonra feilin üçüncü forması işlədilir.

questions.explanation: Never already makes the sentence negative, and it goes after have.
questions.explanationTranslation: Never cümləni artıq inkar edir və have-dən sonra gəlir.

questions.explanation: With she we use has + past participle.
questions.explanationTranslation: She ilə has + feilin üçüncü forması işlədilir.

questions.prompt: My brother has never ___ (see) a doctor about his back.
questions.promptTranslation: Qardaşım beli ilə bağlı heç vaxt həkimə müraciət etməyib.
questions.explanation: See is irregular: see - saw - seen.
questions.explanationTranslation: See qaydasız feildir: see - saw - seen.

questions.prompt: Have you ever ___ (take) this medicine before?
questions.promptTranslation: Bu dərmanı əvvəllər heç qəbul etmisən?
questions.explanation: Take is irregular: take - took - taken.
questions.explanationTranslation: Take qaydasız feildir: take - took - taken.
